operation.geometry: Positive T/S/E/N/K, K%16=0; A_slots1 orS. A dense or existing shared zero-slot-stride contiguous-K proof with actual element-aligned token padding; remaining ports dense.
operation.domain: IDs all in[0,E) before expert access. Finite A; selected SF finite/nonnegative including both zero signs; selected WG/IG positive finite including F32 subnormals. Unselected metadata is not scanned.
operation.math: For each selected expert, original group16 A absmax/E4M3 scale rounding and 1e-5 guard; E2M1 RNE QDQ narrowed to BF16. W narrows BF16 after E2M1code * F32(E4M3SF*WG), with code8 positive zero. Backend F32 reduction then BF16 output; finite scaling overflow/NaN behavior retained.
